speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Membranous Nephropathy secondary to chronic bronchitis (smoking-associated).

The clinical picture of nephrotic syndrome in a 66-year-old male with a history of chronic bronchitis strongly points to membranous nephropathy, which is a common cause of primary nephrotic syndrome in older adults. Do you have any history of deep vein thrombosis, such as a clot in the leg or pulmonary embolism?
